meta.written_by_hand: the spec of core/flightcore/src/impact.rs, replayed by Rust, Swift and Deno

rules.visibility: < 1 sm severe (both), < 3 moderate, <= 5 minor (arrivals); fog names it once
rules.wind: gust >= 40 or wind >= 35 severe, gust >= 30 or wind >= 25 moderate, gust >= 25 or wind >= 20 minor; arrivals
rules.thunderstorm: TS on the field severe, VCTS moderate; both
rules.freezing: FZRA, FZDZ, PL severe; FZFG moderate; both
rules.snow: +SN or BLSN severe, SN moderate; both
rules.fog: FG moderate, arrivals; MIFG, BCFG, PRFG and VCFG do not count
